hook: "If you have never tried, negative hooks works quite well in ads"
body: Kanish Digital's negative-hook thesis: negative hooks work well — 'This product should be banned,' 'Don't buy this for your kid,' 'I am so angry on this product.' For one baby care brand, the best-performing ad is not just a negative hook but a negative ad.
idea: The zero-star ad is the fullest expression of the negative hook — a bad review that sells.
sequencing: The claim: negative hooks work well.
The examples: 'should be banned,' 'don't buy this for your kid,' 'I am so angry.'
The escalation: a full negative ad beats a negative hook.
The LC application: a 1-star review complaining the jewelry is 'too waterproof.'
why_it_works: Negativity is a pattern interrupt — the brain must resolve the complaint, and the resolution is the pitch.
what_to_steal: LC's zero-star ad: a 1-star review complaining the jewelry is 'too waterproof' or 'too shiny.'
